# Set-up
```{r}

set.seed(42)

cran_packages <- c("knitr", "tidyverse", "here", "gridExtra")

missing_cran <- setdiff(cran_packages, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(missing_cran) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_cran)
}

if (!requireNamespace("langcog", quietly = TRUE)) {
  if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("remotes")
  remotes::install_github("langcog/langcog")
}

require(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(langcog)

# set default code chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = T, warning = F, message = F)

# set default plot theme
theme_set(theme_classic() +
            theme(text = element_text(size = 18)))

# suppress warnings about grouping
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = F)
```

# Data

```{r}

source_rmd <- function(rmd_path) {
  tmp_r <- tempfile(fileext = ".R")
  knitr::purl(rmd_path, output = tmp_r, quiet = TRUE)
  sys.source(tmp_r, envir = globalenv())
}

# som.Rmd sources e1-e4 itself; the supplementary figures also need its models
source_rmd(here("code", "analyses", "som.Rmd"))

```

## Build Time vs. Difficulty Rating

```{r}
# Segment data for "7_Number"
segment_build_diff_7 <- df.e1_full_summary %>%
  filter(trial == "7_Number") %>%
  dplyr::summarize(x_start = mean_diff[easy_hard == "easy"],
            y_start = mean_build[easy_hard == "easy"],
            x_end = mean_diff[easy_hard == "hard"],
            y_end = mean_build[easy_hard == "hard"])

# Segment data for "12_Number"
segment_build_diff_17 <- df.e1_full_summary %>%
  filter(trial == "17_InitNumber") %>%
  dplyr::summarize(x_start = mean_diff[easy_hard == "easy"],
            y_start = mean_build[easy_hard == "easy"],
            x_end = mean_diff[easy_hard == "hard"],
            y_end = mean_build[easy_hard == "hard"])

# Segment data for "34_Stability"
segment_build_diff_18 <- df.e1_full_summary %>%
  filter(trial == "18_Stability") %>%
  dplyr::summarize(x_start = mean_diff[easy_hard == "easy"],
            y_start = mean_build[easy_hard == "easy"],
            x_end = mean_diff[easy_hard == "hard"],
            y_end = mean_build[easy_hard == "hard"])


p_builddiff <- NULL
p_builddiff <- ggplot(data = df.e1_full_summary, aes(x = mean_diff, y = mean_build)) +
  geom_point(data = df.e1_full_summary %>% filter(trial != "7_Number" & trial != "17_InitNumber" & trial != "18_Stability"), color = "black", size = 3, alpha = .5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", size = 3) +
  # Triangle pairs (light and dark orange)
  geom_point(data = df.e1_full_summary %>% filter(trial == "7_Number", easy_hard == "easy"), color = "#F5B357", size = 10, shape = 17) +
  geom_point(data = df.e1_full_summary %>% filter(trial == "7_Number", easy_hard == "hard"), color = "#EC9C54", size = 10, shape = 25, fill = "#EC9C54") +
  # Circle pairs (light and dark blue)
  geom_point(data = df.e1_full_summary %>% filter(trial == "17_InitNumber", easy_hard == "easy"), color = "#96BFE8", size = 12, shape = 16) +
  geom_point(data = df.e1_full_summary %>% filter(trial == "17_InitNumber", easy_hard == "hard"), color = "#4E95D9", size = 6.5, shape = 4, stroke = 4) +
  # Square pairs (light and dark green)
  geom_point(data = df.e1_full_summary %>% filter(trial == "18_Stability", easy_hard == "easy"), color = "#A8E480", size = 11, shape = 15) +
  geom_point(data = df.e1_full_summary %>% filter(trial == "18_Stability", easy_hard == "hard"), color = "#0B6623", size = 10, shape = 23, fill = "#0B6623") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 80), breaks = c(0, 40, 80)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 80), breaks = c(0, 40, 80)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Helvetica Neue"),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 33, family = "Helvetica Neue"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 33, family = "Helvetica Neue"),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.25, "cm"),  # Makes tick marks longer
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1.5)   # Makes tick marks thicker
  ) +
  labs(title = "",
       x = "Mean Difficulty Rating (0-100)",
       y = "Mean Build Time (s)")

ggsave(here("figs", "plots", "TED_Fig1_BuildDiff.jpg"), plot = p_builddiff, width = 9.2, height = 7.2, units = "in")

# Print the plot to view it in RStudio
print(p_builddiff)
```

# Figure 2: The big plot

## Combine Summary Data

```{r}

# reset the seed so these bootstrapped CIs don't depend on the chunks above
set.seed(42)

df.e2aadultfc_summary <- df.e2adultfc_combined_long |>
  group_by(trial) |>
  multi_boot_standard(col = "correct") |>
  mutate(dataset = "US Adults") |>
  #get rid of trial that was left out of Tsimane and Lookit
  filter(trial != "TwoPile_Castle")

df.e2b_childfc_summary <- df.e2b_online |>
  mutate(dataset = if_else(age < 6,
                           "US Children (3-5 years)",
                           "US Children (6-8 years)")) |>
  group_by(dataset, trial) |>
  multi_boot_standard(col = "correct") |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(trial))

df.e3_childfc_summary <- df.e3_childfc |>
  select(correct,
         trial) |>
  group_by(trial) |>
  multi_boot_standard(col = "correct") |>
  mutate(dataset = "Tsimane' Children")

df.e2a_2b_3_summary <- full_join(df.e2aadultfc_summary,
          full_join(df.e2b_childfc_summary, df.e3_childfc_summary)) |>
  # older children next to the adults
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = c("US Adults",
                                              "US Children (6-8 years)",
                                              "US Children (3-5 years)",
                                              "Tsimane' Children")))

```

## Plot

```{r}

# Custom color palette
custom_palette <- c(
  "US Adults" = "white",
  "US Children (3-5 years)" = "gray70",
  "US Children (6-8 years)" = "black",
  "Tsimane' Children" = "gray30"
)

p.figure2_data <- ggplot(df.e2a_2b_3_summary, aes(x = dataset,
                                                   y = mean,
                                                   fill = dataset)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
           color = "black",
           width = .5,
           size = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lower,
                    ymax = ci_upper),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
                width = 0.15,
                size = 1.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = .50,
             linetype = "dashed",
             alpha = .5) +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(trial, c("Number1",
                                "Number2",
                                "Number3",
                                "Number4",
                                "Stability",
                                "Number&Stability",
                                "Process1",
                                "Process2",
                                "Pattern",
                                "Probability",
                                "Agent1",
                                "Agent2",
                                "Agent3")),
             scales = "free_x",
             nrow = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_palette, name = "Dataset") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(title = "",
       x = "",
       y = "Percentage Correct") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Helvetica Neue"),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 48, family = "Helvetica Neue"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 46, family = "Helvetica Neue"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 30, family = "Helvetica Neue"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 32, family = "Helvetica Neue"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 24, family = "Helvetica Neue"),
    panel.spacing = unit(3,"lines")
  )


ggsave(here("figs", "plots", "TED_Fig2_Accuracy.jpg"), width = 32, height = 14, p.figure2_data, dpi = 300)

# Print the plot to view it in RStudio
print(p.figure2_data)
```

# Figure 3: Age Curves (Experiment 2b, Online Sample)

```{r}

# ggemmeans() names the grouping term "group" rather than "trial", so rename
# before joining on trial below
df.e2b_age_analysis_named <- e2b_age_analysis_raw |>
  rename(trial = group)

df.e2b_age_predictions <- df.e2b_age_predictions |>
  mutate(min_age = case_when(min_age == "did not pass .5" ~ NA,
                             .default = as.numeric(min_age)))

df.e2b_predict_age <- full_join(df.e2b_age_predictions, df.e2b_age_analysis_named, by = "trial") |>
  mutate(age = x)

# Create a data frame for unique min_age values and their positions
df.e2b_unique_min_age <- df.e2b_predict_age %>%
  dplyr::select(trial, min_age) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  mutate(text_label = case_when(
    is.na(min_age) ~ "N/A",
    TRUE ~ sprintf("%.2f", min_age) # keep two decimals (3.40, not 3.4)
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(min_age))

p.figure3 <- ggplot(df.e2b_predict_age, aes(x = age, y = predicted)) +
  geom_line(color = "gray30", size = 2.25) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), alpha = .2, fill = "gray30") +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = min_age), alpha = .2, color = "black", size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = .5, linetype = "dashed", alpha = .35) +
  geom_text(data = df.e2b_unique_min_age,
            aes(x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = text_label),
            hjust = 1.2, vjust = -2, size = 12) +
  # same panel order as Figure 2
  facet_wrap(~ factor(trial, c("Number1",
                               "Number2",
                               "Number3",
                               "Number4",
                               "Stability",
                               "Number&Stability",
                               "Process1",
                               "Process2",
                               "Pattern",
                               "Probability",
                               "Agent1",
                               "Agent2",
                               "Agent3")),
             scales = "free_x",
             nrow = 3) +
  geom_jitter(data = df.e2b_online,
              aes(x = age, y = correct),
              width = 0,
              height = .05,
              alpha = .05,
              size = 5) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 36, family = "Helvetica Neue"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 28, family = "Helvetica Neue"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 45, family = "Helvetica Neue"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 28, family = "Helvetica Neue"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 30, family = "Helvetica Neue"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 50, family = "Helvetica Neue")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1),
                     labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(3, 9),
                     breaks = c(3, 5, 7, 9)) +
  labs(x = "Age (years)",
       y = "Percentage Correct")

# Print the plot to view it in RStudio
print(p.figure3)

# Save the plot to a file with specific dimensions
ggsave(here("figs", "plots", "TED_Fig3_AgeCurves.png"),
       plot = p.figure3,
       width = 24,
       height = 14,
       dpi = 300)
```

# Figure 4: VR Data

```{r}

# correctly reorder the Tower_Type factor
df.e4_vr$Tower_Type <- factor(df.e4_vr$Tower_Type,
                              levels = c("5 Horizontal", "10 Horizontal", "3x3",
                                         "5 Vertical", "L-Shaped", "10 Vertical"))

# recalculate means with the new order
df.e4_vr_means <- df.e4_vr %>%
  group_by(Tower_Type, Friction_Level) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(Mean_Difficulty = mean(Difficulty, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = 'drop')

df.e4_vr_segments <- df.e4_vr_means %>%
  group_by(Tower_Type) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(xstart = first(Friction_Level),
            xend = last(Friction_Level),
            ystart = first(Mean_Difficulty),
            yend = last(Mean_Difficulty),
            .groups = 'drop')

# update the plot with the new order
p_e4_vrdata <- ggplot(df.e4_vr, aes(x = Friction_Level,
                    y = Difficulty,
                    color = Tower_Type)) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0,
              width = .1,
              alpha = .15,
              size = 3) +
  geom_segment(data = df.e4_vr_segments,
               aes(x = xstart,
                   xend = xend,
                   y = ystart,
                   yend = yend),
               linetype = "dashed",
               color = "black",
               alpha = .8,
               linewidth = 1.5) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot",
               geom = "pointrange",
               size = 1.25,
               linewidth = 2) +
  facet_grid(~ Tower_Type,
             scales = "free_y",
             space = "free_x") +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.4, 0.4)) +
  labs(x = "Friction Level",
       y = "Difficulty Rating \n(1-10)") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("5 Horizontal" = "#8DE18F",
                               "10 Horizontal" = "#8DE18F",
                               "3x3" = "#52D356",
                               "5 Vertical" = "#2CAF30",
                               "L-Shaped" = "#1F7B22",
                               "10 Vertical" = "#124713")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 18, family = "Helvetica Neue"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 26, family = "Helvetica Neue"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 20)), # Adds 20 points of space above the x-axis label
    axis.text = element_text(size = 28, family = "Helvetica Neue"),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none")

ggsave(here("figs", "plots", "TED_Fig4_VRData.jpg"), width = 20, height = 4.45, p_e4_vrdata, dpi = 300)

# Print the plot to view it in RStudio
print(p_e4_vrdata)

```

# Supplementary Figures

## Experiment 1: Original vs. Replication Correlations

```{r fig.width = 15, fig.height = 10}

# layers shared by all six panels: Figure 1's axes, plain points
e1_scatter <- list(
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.8),
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.5),
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 80), breaks = c(0, 40, 80)),
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 80), breaks = c(0, 40, 80)),
  theme(axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
)

# original dataset
p_orig_builddiff <- ggplot(df.e1_orig_full_summary,
                           aes(x = mean_diff, y = mean_build)) +
  e1_scatter +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.3, vjust = -1.6, size = 5,
           label = sprintf("r = %.2f", cor(df.e1_orig_full_summary$mean_diff,
                                           df.e1_orig_full_summary$mean_build))) +
  labs(x = "Mean Difficulty Rating (0-100)", y = "Mean Build Time (s)")

p_orig_buildtime <- ggplot(df.e1_orig_full_summary,
                           aes(x = mean_time, y = mean_build)) +
  e1_scatter +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.3, vjust = -1.6, size = 5,
           label = sprintf("r = %.2f", cor(df.e1_orig_full_summary$mean_time,
                                           df.e1_orig_full_summary$mean_build))) +
  labs(x = "Mean Time Estimation (0-100)", y = "Mean Build Time (s)")

p_orig_difftime <- ggplot(df.e1_orig_full_summary,
                          aes(x = mean_time, y = mean_diff)) +
  e1_scatter +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.3, vjust = -1.6, size = 5,
           label = sprintf("r = %.2f", cor(df.e1_orig_full_summary$mean_time,
                                           df.e1_orig_full_summary$mean_diff))) +
  labs(x = "Mean Time Estimation (0-100)",
       y = "Mean Difficulty Rating (0-100)")

# replication dataset
p_rep_builddiff <- ggplot(df.e1_rep_full_summary,
                          aes(x = mean_diff, y = mean_build)) +
  e1_scatter +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.3, vjust = -1.6, size = 5,
           label = sprintf("r = %.2f", cor(df.e1_rep_full_summary$mean_diff,
                                           df.e1_rep_full_summary$mean_build))) +
  labs(x = "Mean Difficulty Rating (0-100)", y = "Mean Build Time (s)")

p_rep_buildtime <- ggplot(df.e1_rep_full_summary,
                          aes(x = mean_time, y = mean_build)) +
  e1_scatter +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.3, vjust = -1.6, size = 5,
           label = sprintf("r = %.2f", cor(df.e1_rep_full_summary$mean_time,
                                           df.e1_rep_full_summary$mean_build))) +
  labs(x = "Mean Time Estimation (0-100)", y = "Mean Build Time (s)")

p_rep_difftime <- ggplot(df.e1_rep_full_summary,
                         aes(x = mean_time, y = mean_diff)) +
  e1_scatter +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.3, vjust = -1.6, size = 5,
           label = sprintf("r = %.2f", cor(df.e1_rep_full_summary$mean_time,
                                           df.e1_rep_full_summary$mean_diff))) +
  labs(x = "Mean Time Estimation (0-100)",
       y = "Mean Difficulty Rating (0-100)")

# one row of three panels per dataset, each with a header above it
p_e1_orig_rep <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
  gridExtra::arrangeGrob(p_orig_builddiff, p_orig_buildtime, p_orig_difftime,
                         nrow = 1,
                         top = grid::textGrob("Original Dataset",
                                              gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 22,
                                                              fontface = "bold"))),
  gridExtra::arrangeGrob(p_rep_builddiff, p_rep_buildtime, p_rep_difftime,
                         nrow = 1,
                         top = grid::textGrob("Replication Dataset",
                                              gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 22,
                                                              fontface = "bold"))),
  ncol = 1)

grid::grid.draw(p_e1_orig_rep)

ggsave(here("figs", "plots", "som_e1_orig_rep.pdf"), plot = p_e1_orig_rep,
       width = 15, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

## Experiment 2b: Age Curves, All Samples Combined

```{r}

ggplot(df.e2b_age_combined, aes(x = age, y = predicted)) +
  # fixed seed: leaves the global RNG stream (and later bootstraps) untouched
  geom_point(data = df.e2b_all_samples, aes(y = correct),
             position = position_jitter(width = 0, height = .05, seed = 1),
             alpha = .06, size = 0.5) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
              alpha = .2, fill = "gray30") +
  geom_line(colour = "gray30", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = .5, linetype = "dashed", alpha = .35) +
  geom_vline(data = filter(df.e2b_success_combined,
                           !is.na(min_age), min_age > youngest),
             aes(xintercept = min_age), alpha = .2, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(data = df.e2b_success_combined,
            aes(x = Inf, y = .25, label = label),
            hjust = 1.1, size = 2.4) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, .5, 1),
                     labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = "Percentage correct") +
```

## Experiments 2a, 2b and 3: Model vs. Accuracy by Age Group

```{r fig.width = 18, fig.height = 5.5}

# observed accuracy and the full model's difficulty ratio for the ten pairs,
# one row per sample and trial
df.model_2afc_scatter <- bind_rows(df.e2a_model_summary,
                                   df.e2b_model_summary,
                                   df.e3_model_summary) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(trial, dataset, accuracy = mean) |>
  left_join(select(df.model_2afc, trial, full), by = "trial") |>
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = c("US Adults", "US Children",
                                              "Tsimane' Children")))

# US children, split into the younger (3-5) and older (6-8) age groups
df.e2b_age_scatter <- df.e2b_online |>
  filter(trial %in% df.model_2afc$trial)|>
  mutate(age_bin = if_else(age_group == "3-5", "3- to 5-year-olds",
                           "6- to 8-year-olds")) |>
  dplyr::summarise(accuracy = mean(correct), .by = c(age_bin, trial)) |>
  left_join(select(df.model_2afc, trial, full), by = "trial") |>
  rename(panel = age_bin)

# Tsimane' children and US adults, pooled across age
df.age_panel_levels <- c("US Adults",
                         "3- to 5-year-olds",
                         "6- to 8-year-olds",
                         "Tsimane' Children")

df.e2b_age_scatter <- df.model_2afc_scatter |>
  filter(dataset %in% c("Tsimane' Children", "US Adults")) |>
  transmute(panel = as.character(dataset), trial, accuracy, full) |>
  bind_rows(df.e2b_age_scatter) |>
  mutate(panel = factor(panel, levels = df.age_panel_levels))

# layers shared by the four panels: chance lines, the same axes in every panel
e2_age_scatter <- list(
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey80"),
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey80"),
  # group = 1 so the fit is per panel, not per trial (colour = trial would
  # otherwise split the data into single-point groups)
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "grey70",
              linewidth = 0.8),
  geom_point(aes(colour = trial), size = 3, alpha = 0.7),
  scale_x_continuous(limits = range(df.e2b_age_scatter$accuracy),
                     breaks = c(0.5, 0.7, 0.9)),
  scale_y_continuous(limits = range(df.e2b_age_scatter$full),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.18, 0.05))),
  labs(x = "Proportion Correct", y = "Full Model\nDifficulty Ratio",
       colour = "Trial"),
  theme(axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 20),
        legend.position = "none")
)

df.e2b_age_adults <- filter(df.e2b_age_scatter, panel == "US Adults")
df.e2b_age_3to5 <- filter(df.e2b_age_scatter, panel == "3- to 5-year-olds")
df.e2b_age_6to8 <- filter(df.e2b_age_scatter, panel == "6- to 8-year-olds")
df.e2b_age_tsimane <- filter(df.e2b_age_scatter, panel == "Tsimane' Children")

p_e2_age_adults <- ggplot(df.e2b_age_adults, aes(x = accuracy, y = full)) +
  e2_age_scatter +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.3, vjust = -1.6, size = 5,
           label = sprintf("r = %.2f", cor(df.e2b_age_adults$accuracy,
                                           df.e2b_age_adults$full))) +
  labs(title = "US Adults")

p_e2_age_3to5 <- ggplot(df.e2b_age_3to5, aes(x = accuracy, y = full)) +
  e2_age_scatter +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.3, vjust = -1.6, size = 5,
           label = sprintf("r = %.2f", cor(df.e2b_age_3to5$accuracy,
                                           df.e2b_age_3to5$full))) +
  labs(title = "US Children, 3-5 Years")

p_e2_age_6to8 <- ggplot(df.e2b_age_6to8, aes(x = accuracy, y = full)) +
  e2_age_scatter +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.3, vjust = -1.6, size = 5,
           label = sprintf("r = %.2f", cor(df.e2b_age_6to8$accuracy,
                                           df.e2b_age_6to8$full))) +
  labs(title = "US Children, 6-8 Years")

p_e2_age_tsimane <- ggplot(df.e2b_age_tsimane, aes(x = accuracy, y = full)) +
  e2_age_scatter +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.3, vjust = -1.6, size = 5,
           label = sprintf("r = %.2f", cor(df.e2b_age_tsimane$accuracy,
                                           df.e2b_age_tsimane$full))) +
  labs(title = "Tsimane' Children")

# the trial legend, taken from one panel and shown once, to the right
e2_age_legend <- gtable::gtable_filter(
  ggplotGrob(p_e2_age_tsimane + theme(legend.position = "right")),
  "guide-box-right")

# side by side; cbind() lines up their panels
p_e2_age_model <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
  cbind(ggplotGrob(p_e2_age_adults), ggplotGrob(p_e2_age_3to5),
        ggplotGrob(p_e2_age_6to8), ggplotGrob(p_e2_age_tsimane),
        size = "max"),
  e2_age_legend,
  ncol = 2, widths = c(8, 1.2))

grid::grid.draw(p_e2_age_model)

ggsave(here("figs", "plots", "som_e2a_e2b_e3_model.pdf"), plot = p_e2_age_model,
       width = 18, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)

```

## Experiment 4: Data vs. Full Model

```{r fig.width = 14, fig.height = 9}

# both rows z-scored, so the data and the model share one scale
df.e4_model_fig <- df.e4_model_and_data |>
  mutate(Data = (mean_diff - mean(mean_diff)) / sd(mean_diff),
         Full = (full - mean(full)) / sd(full)) |>
  select(Tower_Type, Friction_Level, Data, Full)

# layers shared by both rows: one panel per tower, the same y range
e4_lines <- list(
  facet_wrap(~ Tower_Type, nrow = 1),
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.3, 0.3)),
  scale_y_continuous(limits = range(select(df.e4_model_fig, -Tower_Type,
                                           -Friction_Level))),
  theme(axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 22))
)

p_e4_data <- ggplot(df.e4_model_fig,
                    aes(x = Friction_Level, y = Data, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  e4_lines +
  labs(title = "Empirical Data", x = "Friction Level",
       y = "Mean Difficulty Rating\n(z-scored)")

p_e4_model <- ggplot(df.e4_model_fig,
                     aes(x = Friction_Level, y = Full, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, colour = "firebrick", linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, colour = "firebrick") +
  e4_lines +
  labs(title = "Full Model Predictions", x = "Friction Level",
       y = "Model Predicted Difficulty\n(z-scored)")

# stack the two plots; rbind() lines up their panels
p_e4_model_data <- rbind(ggplotGrob(p_e4_data), ggplotGrob(p_e4_model),
                         size = "max")

grid::grid.draw(p_e4_model_data)

ggsave(here("figs", "plots", "som_e4_model_full.pdf"), plot = p_e4_model_data,
       width = 12, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```
